sources.snippet: LTX2.3-ICEdit-Insight is a task-aware video restoration and editing model family developed by JoyFox Lab, built on top of the LTX-2.3 DiT-based audio-video foundation model. This release focuses on four practical video editing directions: Video Restoration: degradation recovery, compression cleanup, blur and noise reduction, and damaged detail restoration.
